title: CE认证与TUV测试报告

intro.background: CE标志不是测试报告，是制造商自我声明。流程：选指令（Toys Safety Directive 2009/48/EC）→ 做EN71/EN1176测试 → 出具DoC符合性声明 → 贴CE标。客户要的文件通常包括：Test Report、DoC、ISO9001工厂证书。

oneLiner.en: CE is a self-declaration, not a test report — but it must be backed by valid EN test reports.
oneLiner.cn: CE是自我声明，不是测试报告——但背后必须有有效的EN测试报告。

vocab.ex: All EU products must bear CE marking.
We issue a DoC for each product.
TUV Rheinland is a reputable lab.
SGS is another major testing company.
vocab.exCn: SGS是另一家大型测试公司。

vocab.ex: The notified body number is on the CE mark.

mistakes.right: We have a CE DoC, backed by EN71 test reports from TUV.

basic.en: We issue a CE Declaration of Conformity.
The test report is from TUV Rheinland.
We can send the full CE file.
CE is mandatory for the EU.

advanced.en: Our complete CE package includes the DoC, EN71 test reports from TUV Rheinland, and our ISO9001 certificate — all in English.
advanced.cn: 我们完整CE包包括DoC、TUV EN71报告、ISO9001证书——全英文。
advanced.from: We can send the full CE file.

advanced.en: The CE marking is on each product with the notified body number and file reference for full traceability.
advanced.cn: CE标志贴在每个产品上，带公告机构号和档案编号，可追溯。
advanced.from: We issue a CE Declaration of Conformity.

lines.speaker: client
lines.en: Can you provide the CE file? Our customs need it.
lines.cn: 能提供CE文件吗？我们清关需要。

lines.speaker: you
lines.en: Sure. The CE package includes the DoC, EN71 test reports from TUV, and our ISO9001 certificate. I will email all of them.
lines.cn: 好的。CE包包括DoC、TUV EN71报告、ISO9001证书。我都发您邮箱。

lines.speaker: client
lines.en: Is the DoC signed by your company?

lines.speaker: you
lines.en: Yes, signed by our legal representative with company stamp. It lists the relevant harmonized standards.
lines.cn: 是的，法人代表签字盖公章。还列出适用的协调标准。

scenario.q: A customs broker asks for the CE file. What do you send?
scenario.modelAnswer: I send three documents: 1) the CE DoC signed by our legal representative, 2) EN71 test reports from TUV Rheinland, 3) our ISO9001 factory certificate. All in English.
scenario.cn: 我发三份：1）法人代表签的CE DoC；2）TUV莱茵EN71报告；3）ISO9001证书。全英文。

checklist: 我能列出需要的3份文件

culture.title: CE常见误区
culture.content: 误区1：CE是测试认证——错，CE是自我声明。误区2：CE标随便贴——错，背后要有测试报告。误区3：一个CE用所有产品——错，不同产品要分别测试。
